QuestInfo.name: Making Memories
QuestInfo.0: There is a boy standing next to The Viking. Go see what he's looking at.
QuestInfo.1: Leave a mark near The Viking to show you've been there.
QuestInfo.2: You left your mark at The Viking.

yes.0: Here, you try. It's fun! No one will ever know.
